response.original_title: Dance till the love is gone
response.overview: Character 1 is a painter working on a project in his studio. Character 2 is a skater, traveling through the city of Lima. Eventually, both head to a rave, where they end up crossing paths. During the party, they catch each other’s gaze and draw closer. Upon meeting, they greet one another with a nervous kiss on the cheek. This gesture triggers an aerial dance on silks—a dimension that exists solely between them—where they once again merge into one. Inevitably, they return to reality, finding themselves staring fixedly at each other amidst a sea of ​​people. They simply smile and continue on their separate ways.
response.title: Dance till the love is gone
